buildings.name: Heritage Hall
buildings.description: Built in 1922 and artfully restored in 2001, SAIT's beautiful Heritage Hall is a national historic site and iconic symbol for both SAIT and Calgary.

buildings.name: Clayton Carroll Automotive Centre
buildings.description: The Clayton Carroll Automotive Centre defines the west entrance to campus and is home to SAIT's automotive programs classrooms and labs.

buildings.name: Aldred Centre
buildings.description: The Aldred Centre features modern classrooms, advanced laboratories, and industry-grade equipment and provides students with hands-on experience to prepare for their future careers.

buildings.name: East Hall Residence
buildings.description: East Hall Residence at SAIT offers comfortable, on-campus living accommodations with a range of amenities designed to support students' academic and social needs.

buildings.name: John Ware Building
buildings.description: The revitalized John Ware Building is home to SAIT's School of Hospitality and Tourism's main office, classrooms and labs, and student-run amenities including the Highwood Restaurant and the Culinary Campus International Market.

buildings.name: E.H. Crandell Building
buildings.description: Located off 16th Ave, the E.H. Crandell Building is one of SAIT's main distribution and on campus service centres.

offices-services.name: School of Hospitality and Tourism main office

buildings.name: Begin Tower Residence
buildings.description: The Begin Tower at SAIT is a modern residence building providing comfortable and convenient accommodations for students, complete with various amenities to support a vibrant campus life.

buildings.name: Cenovus Energy Centre
buildings.description: With its unmistakable glass arch roof, the Cenovus Energy Centre provides multiple opportunities for energy and engineering focused hands-on learning and innovation.

buildings.name: Johnson-Cobbe Energy Centre
buildings.description: As one of the three buildings included in the Trades and Technology Complex, The Johnson-Cobbe Energy Centre provides specialized facilities and resources for training in energy-related technologies and trades.

offices-services.name: MacPhail School of Energy main office

buildings.name: Green Building Technologies
buildings.description: <span>The Green Building Technologies Lab and Demonstration Center is Calgary's first commercial Net Zero building, featuring a solar lab, rainwater harvesting, passive heating and a solar carport with electric vehicle charging ports.</span>

buildings.name: Stan Grad Centre
buildings.description: <span>The Stan Grad Centre is a hub for student activity on campus housing classrooms, eateries, the SAIT Bookstore, the Reg Erhardt Library, the Irene Lewis Atrium and much more.</span>

offices-services.name: Continuing Education and Professional Studies
offices-services.room: MB107 (enter from outside by Security Office)

offices-services.name: School for Advanced Digital Technology main office

buildings.name: Senator Burns Building
buildings.description: <span>The 11-storey Senator Burns Building is the home to essential business offices at SAIT and a variety of student resource centres including the Natoysopoyiis. </span>

offices-services.name: School of Health and Public Safety main office

buildings.name: Eugene Coste Building
buildings.description: Adjoined to the east side of the Cenovus Energy Centre, the Eugene Coste building is home to essential on campus services including campus security.

buildings.name: Thomas Riley Building
buildings.description: <span>Thomas Riley Building contains classrooms and labs essential for programs focused on construction, manufacturing, and automation.</span>

buildings.name: Wellness Centre
buildings.description: <span>The temporary gym at SAIT offers students and staff access to cardio machines, free weights and a full-size basketball court, which can also be used for badminton and volleyball.</span>
